results.statement: atm-bd must not assign dev or fix beads; the lead assigns them, the dev starts its next queued task when the sanity hook closes its current task, and a qa fix bead goes to the dev the lead picks at the finding's difficulty.
results.quote: dev assignment is not mechanical.  this works as it does now.  dev agent will start next queued task as soon as sanity pass.  a different dev will get qa fix beads at appropriate level set by lead.
